title: Typed frame contract and deterministic locomotion replay matrix
problem: Critical locomotion values cross UE world, actor, mesh, animation-data, canonical Proto, and policy heading-local frames as plain FVector/FQuat. E74-E77 tested coordinate hypotheses in full Chaos. E77 selects Walk_Fwd but its roughly 300 cm/s authored root motion conflicts with the locked 160 cm/s shell trajectory.
single_change: Add pure typed frame adapters and an eight-case deterministic replay matrix. E79 changes no runtime behavior.
acceptance: Future root has positive route projection and speed within five percent of 160 cm/s.
Turn sign, zero velocity, and world-data-world round trips are exact.
Current and future states use one selected world-to-data transform.
Typed canonical observation and mimic tensors are finite and have locked widths.
Exactly one case survives: E77 query plus QueryTrajectoryRootMotion.
next_if_supported: Use only the unique survivor in a separately preregistered runtime change, then run one authoritative v2 probe.
